generator.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: isolated environment background plate for a bounded central room stage in a survival strategy game. Generate exactly one new native 3840 x 2160 PNG, 16:9, without enlarging a smaller image. Scene P0: a long industrial cable distribution corridor inside an aging electric utility substation. Dense banks of thick neatly routed black insulated cables on overhead metal ladder trays and wall-mounted cable racks, weathered grey-green enclosed electrical cabinets lining both sides, concrete utility walls with heavy conduits and metal mounting brackets. This is clearly power infrastructure, not a hospital hallway: no hospital tiles, handrails, medical furniture, hotel fittings, elevator doors. A wide empty central walkway leads to a dark plain service doorway in the distant background. Cabinets remain fully closed with plain handles and unlit blank instrument windows; no exposed electric arc, no active status screens, no colored control indicator pattern. Construction and cabling physically plausible, practical industrial scale. Cinematic photorealistic game illustration, dense crisp texture in cable insulation, oxidized metal, grey-green powder-coat paint, dusty concrete and metal floor grates, sparse scuffing and moisture without flooding. Lighting: restrained cold cyan overhead utility illumination, a few faint amber maintenance wall lamps along the side; these are local environment lamps, not an indication that any power-restoration objective is completed. Deep teal-black shadows but readable architecture, quiet tense abandoned mood. Camera at eye height, 28 mm wide architectural perspective with central stable vanishing point at x=50%, y=42%, perfectly level framing. Central 60% of image remains recognizable and unobstructed; empty center foreground floor available for a separate action overlay, main cabinets and trays fit safely inside composition, no critical object touching edges. No human, enemy, NPC, silhouette, body, blood or gore. No HUD, UI, panels, icons, text, letters, words, numbers, labels, signs, hazard lettering, posters, logos or watermark. No loose tools, repair components, batteries, collectibles, supplies, loot or rewards. No triumphant powered-up appearance, success symbol or new gameplay gate. This is presentation-only background art; no gameplay state, movement graph, reward or recovered supply is asserted. Deliver one clean native 3840x2160 full-bleed PNG.
